# heytownhall_members (Data Source)

The organisation's members, owners included. Use it to find a person's `user_id` by email for `heytownhall_member`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "heytownhall_members" "all" {}

output "owner_emails" {
  value = [for m in data.heytownhall_members.all.members : m.email if m.role == "owner"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `members` (Attributes List) The members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) The email address.
- `joined_at` (String) When the person joined (RFC 3339).
- `name` (String) The name.
- `role` (String) `owner` or `member`.
- `user_id` (String) The user id.
